### P6 "CircularHistory" (Compute Shader) · Compute

description: Trail of the last 100 2D points received: every frame the [x, y] pairs in xyBuffer (e.g. Arraygen -> Array to buffer, Float32) are appended to a ring buffer of 100 points on the z = 0 plane; the newest are orange and each older point fades toward transparent black (its colour is premultiplied) and shrinks its sprite_size by 1 % per frame.
